Enter each alias in its indicated field after mdoc restores the value. Complete the **NEEDS-YOU** items directly on the form.

If the family-member exemption at the top of the form applies, leave form fields **21, 22, 30, 31 and 32** blank, including their continuation lines.

### Fields using your restored details

**B01 — Surname**

SURNAME_P1

**B03 — Given names**

GIVEN_P1

MIDDLE_P1

Use the passport’s given-name entry to check whether to include the middle name and in what order.

**B04 — Date of birth**

DATE_P1

If the restored date uses a different format, rewrite it on the form in day-month-year order, with a four-digit year.

**B05 — Place of birth**

PLACE_P1

**B13 — Passport number**

ID_P1

**B14 — Passport issue date**

ISSUED_P1

If the form requires a different date format, rewrite the restored date by hand.

**B19 — Home address**

ADDRESS_P1

**NEEDS-YOU** — Add your email address.

**B19 — Telephone**

PHONE_P1
